# Monotonic UUIDv7 generator behaviour. "reset" starts a new generator.
#   next <now_ms> <random_hex> <expected>
# random_hex: the 10 bytes the random source returns if the call draws randomness,
#             or "-" if the call must not draw any.
# expected:   the canonical UUID, or "error" (the call fails and the generator is unchanged).
reset
next 1645557742000 7cc398c4dc0c0c07398f 017f22e2-79b0-7cc3-98c4-dc0c0c07398f
next 1645557742000 - 017f22e2-79b0-7cc3-98c4-dc0c0c073990
next 1645557741995 - 017f22e2-79b0-7cc3-98c4-dc0c0c073991
next 1645557742001 3b340066eb0a96865089 017f22e2-79b1-7b34-8066-eb0a96865089
reset
next 1000 0000ffffffffffffffff 00000000-03e8-7000-bfff-ffffffffffff
next 1000 - 00000000-03e8-7001-8000-000000000000
next 1000 - 00000000-03e8-7001-8000-000000000001
reset
next 2000 ffffffffffffffffffff 00000000-07d0-7fff-bfff-ffffffffffff
next 2000 - error
next 1999 - error
next 2001 7e437a9d4549e9055d80 00000000-07d1-7e43-ba9d-4549e9055d80
reset
next 281474976710656 00000000000000000000 error

next 281474976710656 3797edec7adc7451241e error
next 281474976710655 - ffffffff-ffff-7f6a-a64c-d4750f559023
